name: GTA V versions and editions
summary: GTA V launched on PS3 and Xbox 360 (2013), then PS4/Xbox One (2014), PC (2015), PS5/Xbox Series (2022) and an Enhanced PC edition alongside the Legacy PC edition. Some Story Mode content is version-scoped: Peyote Plants and Monkey Mosaics are not in the PS3/Xbox 360 versions.

sections.title: Version-scoped Story Mode content
sections.text: Peyote Plants (27) exist only on PS4, Xbox One, PC and later. Monkey Mosaics (50) are described as part of the re-release on newer consoles and PC. 100% completion does not require enhanced-edition exclusives (GTABase).

sections.title: Stock market and Railgun
sections.text: Stock returns from Lester's contracts differ between versions (one guide: about +80% on older versions vs about +21% on next-gen for the first contract). Whether the Railgun is available in Story Mode may also depend on the version; sources disagree.

sections.title: Not validated
sections.text: Detailed PC Legacy versus PC Enhanced differences, mod compatibility and per-platform cheat availability are not validated; do not assume compatibility.
